# Bugshot Roulette

> Bugshot Roulette (also searched as Aadish Roulette, BugshotRouleette, Aadish Bugshot, or Buckshot Roulette Web) is a free-to-play, browser-based 3D high-stakes tabletop horror game created by Aadish (@AadishY). It is heavily inspired by Mike Klubnika's Buckshot Roulette, built with React 19, Three.js, React Three Fiber, and TypeScript.

## Quick Facts

- **Creator / Developer**: Aadish (GitHub: https://github.com/AadishY)
- **Live Game URL**: https://bugshotroulette.pages.dev/
- **Source Repository**: https://github.com/AadishY/BugShot-Roulette
- **Genre**: Horror, Strategy, Turn-Based Tabletop, WebGL 3D
- **Game Modes**: Single Player (vs AI Dealer with Normal & Hard Cheating modes), Real-Time Multiplayer (Socket.io)
- **Tech Stack**: React 19, TypeScript, Three.js, React Three Fiber, Tailwind CSS, Socket.io, Vite

## Game Mechanics

1. **The Core Loop**:
   - Both players sit across a dimly lit industrial table with a 12-gauge pump-action shotgun between them.
   - A random magazine of 2 to 8 shells is loaded with a known distribution of Live (red) and Blank (blue) shells.
   - The sequence of shells is hidden.

2. **Actions on Turn**:
   - **Shoot the Opponent / Dealer**: If the shell is LIVE, it inflicts 1 HP of damage (or 2 HP with Hand Saw/Choke). If BLANK, 0 damage. Turn passes to opponent.
   - **Shoot Yourself**: If the shell is BLANK, you retain your turn! If LIVE, you take damage and your turn ends.
   - **Use Items**: Tactical items can be consumed before taking a shot to alter shell polarity, gain intel, heal, or disrupt the opponent.

3. **Item Roster**:
   - **Cigarettes**: Restores 1 HP (capped at max).
   - **Beer**: Ejects the chambered shell without firing it.
   - **Handcuffs**: Skips opponent's next turn.
   - **Magnifying Glass**: Reveals whether the current shell is LIVE or BLANK.
   - **Hand Saw**: Saws the shotgun barrel to deal 2 damage on the next shot.
   - **Burner Phone**: Reveals the state of a future shell (3rd or later; 5% lie chance).
   - **Inverter**: Reverses the current shell polarity (Live <-> Blank).
   - **Big Inverter**: Inverts polarities of all remaining shells in the magazine.
   - **Adrenaline**: Steals and immediately uses an opponent's item.
   - **Remote**: Swaps the current shell with the subsequent shell.
   - **Choke**: Fires current and next shell in a double-barrel volley.
   - **Blood Contract**: Sacrifices 1 HP for 2 high-tier items.
   - **Lucky Charm**: Boosts item drop quality multiplicatively.
   - **Flashbang**: Prevents opponent item usage on their next turn.
   - **Crusher**: Destroys a random item in the opponent's inventory.
   - **Totem of Undying**: Passive auto-save at 1 HP when taking lethal damage.
   - **Mirror**: Replays all items the opponent used during their previous turn.
   - **Tarot Deck**: Draw 1 of 6 fanned cards with wild effects (The Magician, The Moon, Justice, Wheel of Fortune, etc.).
   - **Jackpot Machine**: Gamble for 1 to 3 shots of damage immunity.
